coverage: title + tagline + job relevance + 8 outcomes + 8 theory code/output blocks + 10 callouts + 2 figures

top_level.current_content: Feature engineering y pipelines sin leakage
Tabla de features versionada con train≡serve, sin futuro ni labels de decisión. Ritmo sugerido: unas 9 h para la ruta completa de esta sección según la calibración actual.
top_level.justification: Source tagline is internally consistent with estimatedHours=9. The indexed public card still shows an older 10–18h phrasing, but its crawl is stale so deployment drift remains unresolved rather than a confirmed source defect.

top_level.current_content: Las features mal hechas filtran el futuro (usan datos que solo existirán después de la decisión) y producen modelos que fallan en producción. Aquí aprendes a construir una tabla de features versionada con la misma lógica en entrenamiento e inferencia, sin timestamps futuros ni labels de decisión. Las features de grafo o contacto compartido son señales para el modelo o la cola humana, no etiquetas de fraude ni de parentesco.
top_level.justification: Correctly motivates leakage and preserves the ethical boundary; executable defects are handled in theory/code findings.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Diseñar un feature catalog (numéricas, categóricas y de texto) y validar que las keys del row ⊆ catálogo antes del fit; evidencia: catalog_ok y lista unknown_keys.
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Diseñar un catálogo versionado que declare por feature nombre, ruta/tipo, dtype, rol, política de ausencia, fuente y disponibilidad; validar rutas disjuntas, columnas requeridas/desconocidas, tipos y derivadas antes del fit.
learning_outcomes.justification: Key-subset validation alone is not the catalog contract taught in prose.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Aplicar missing indicators, fill con mediana de train y z-score con μ/σ congelados; demostrar silent_fill=False.
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Ajustar imputación/indicadores/μ/σ solo con train, reconocer las representaciones de missing soportadas, manejar features constantes y demostrar mediante tests que transform reutiliza el estado congelado sin relleno silencioso.
learning_outcomes.justification: A literal `silent_fill=False` is not evidence and current code fails on NaN/sd=0.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Construir features relacionales (shared_address, degree, min path) sin usar label de decisión como input.
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Construir features relacionales desde una vista de grafo versionada y `as_of`, sin labels de decisión; distinguir ausencia de acuerdo, degree de multiarista de vecinos únicos y path ausente de distancia observada, conservando derivación/provenance.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current graph feature helper is static, unauditable and converts missing address into positive evidence.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Calcular conteos y frecuencias en ventanas half-open [t−w, t) documentadas en el catálogo.
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Calcular conteos y frecuencias sobre eventos deduplicados y conocidos al `feature_cutoff`, con ventana positiva half-open documentada, event time/availability time y tests de borde, replay y late arrival.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current demo omits frequency, replay protection and knowledge-time semantics.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Componer transformers custom con fit→transform y cadena por tipo de columna (ruta numérica vs. categórica).
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Componer transformadores custom deterministas y un `Pipeline`/`ColumnTransformer` mínimo para rutas numérica, categórica y de texto; fit solo en train, transform con estado congelado y fallos tipificados para input/estado inválido.
learning_outcomes.justification: The current custom router bypasses fitted state and the roadmap's real ColumnTransformer/text route is absent.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Persistir estado fit (mediana, vocab, version) como JSON fs-vN y reutilizarlo en el batch de serve.
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Persistir y reabrir un manifest de feature set con catálogo/schema, estado completo de transformadores, hashes/versiones y compatibilidad esperada por el modelo; reutilizarlo en serve desde una fuente confiable.
learning_outcomes.justification: In-memory JSON roundtrip plus a caller-provided string is not persistent/version-bound state.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Partir por tiempo y entidad con informe de split: n_train, n_test y overlap de entidades = 0.
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Construir una evaluación temporal y/o group-aware según el estimand, con timestamps timezone-aware, grupos no solapados cuando corresponda, soporte mínimo en train/test y reporte reproducible de tamaños, grupos y exclusiones.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current helper only time-splits then diagnoses overlap and can false-green an empty holdout.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Ejecutar scan de nombres leaky + alerta de skew train–serve y promover solo con feature_set id válido.
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Bloquear promoción mediante metadatos semánticos de leakage, prueba exacta de paridad train–serve sobre los mismos inputs, monitoreo de distribución con tolerancias por feature y manifest compatible; conservar causas de rechazo separadas.
learning_outcomes.justification: Name substrings, mean-only skew and an `fs-vN` prefix cannot prove the final gate.

theory_code_output.title: catalog.py
theory_code_output.current_content: `known = set(schema["numeric"] + schema["categorical"] + schema["text"])`; unknown keys only; `note_len = len(row["note"]) if "note" in row else 0`; output `catalog_ok True unknown []`.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Use a catalog mapping each model feature to route/dtype/role/missing/source/availability/derivation; assert route sets are disjoint; validate required/unknown keys and values; derive `note_len` plus `note_missing` as registered outputs; return typed diagnostics instead of a key-only boolean.
theory_code_output.justification: Current output proves only no extra key in the happy fixture.

theory_code_output.title: missing_scale.py
theory_code_output.current_content: `ind = [v is None for v in vals]`; fill caller literals; `z = [(x-mu)/sd ...]`; final line prints `silent_fill False` literally.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Create `fit_numeric(train)` that learns validated fill/mu/sd and an explicit fitted state; `transform_numeric` recognizes None/NaN, emits indicator, handles constant features by declared policy and derives `silent_fill` from observed missing positions. Add pytest for NaN, sd=0 and transform-before-fit.
theory_code_output.justification: Removes three false guarantees from a demo presented as evidence.

theory_code_output.title: graph_feat.py
theory_code_output.current_content: `shared = int(a.get("addr") == b.get("addr"))`; `degree = len(neighbors.get(e, []))`; `path = paths.get(e+"-"+other, 99)`; output shared=1 degree=2 path=99.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Require `GraphFeatureView(graph_version, as_of, etypes, directions, node_kinds)`; shared=1 only when both normalized attrs are observed; compute and name incident-edge count vs unique-neighbor count separately; canonicalize pair/path lookup; return `path_missing` rather than bare 99; persist edge/evidence derivation refs.
theory_code_output.justification: Current helper can fabricate shared evidence and has no point-in-time or audit contract.

theory_code_output.title: window.py
theory_code_output.current_content: `window_count(events,t,w,closed=False)` counts scalar timestamps; no event ids, availability times or frequency; accepts invalid w; output count=2 closed_bad=3.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Represent events with `record_id`, `event_ts`, `available_at`, channel; validate `w>0`; deduplicate immutable identities; select events satisfying event and knowledge-time policy; compute count plus channel frequencies/support from that one eligible set; pytest exact-t/future/replay/late-arrival.
theory_code_output.justification: The half-open boundary is correct but incomplete as a historical-feature engine.

theory_code_output.title: transformer.py
theory_code_output.current_content: `ModeImputer.fit` uses `max(set(xs), key=xs.count)` including None; MiniPipeline only contains the imputer; `column_router` accepts external numeric fill/scale and silently fills None with 0; no text route.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Use a separate fitted flag, exclude missing from mode, define all-missing behavior and deterministic tie-break; model numeric/categorical/text as fitted transformers; compose them first in a pure-Python pipeline then show the equivalent sklearn `ColumnTransformer` inside `Pipeline`; reject arbitrary serve state.
theory_code_output.justification: Current code is neither deterministic nor a single train=serve preprocessing path.

theory_code_output.title: persist.py
theory_code_output.current_content: `load_state` performs `json.loads(json.dumps(state))`; state is only `{median:2, version:'fs-v1'}`; `apply_median` ignores version; no filesystem/artifact read/write.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Write a JSON manifest to an artifact path, compute content hashes, close/reopen it in a separate serve step, validate complete transformer/catalog state and expected feature_set id/hash before transform. If mentioning joblib/pickle, state trusted-source and dependency-version constraints.
theory_code_output.justification: Demonstrates actual persistence and machine-enforced compatibility.

theory_code_output.title: split.py
theory_code_output.current_content: `train=[r for r in rows if r['ts'] < cut]`; `test=...>=cut`; overlap counted after split; string timestamp comparison; `ok` is only `ov==0`.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Parse timezone-aware timestamps; define chronological holdout plus group policy explicitly; construct or filter to non-overlapping groups when required; assert minimum train/test/group support; report exclusions and zero overlap. Use pytest counterexample with timezone offsets and empty holdout.
theory_code_output.justification: Current function diagnoses one overlap case but is not the split method its name/prose promise.

theory_code_output.title: leakage.py
theory_code_output.current_content: `leak_scan` checks case-sensitive substrings label/decision; `skew_alert` only absolute mean diff; code prints `leaky ['label_decision']`, `skew True`, and `feature_set fs-v2` but never rejects promotion.
theory_code_output.improved_content: Validate feature role/source/availability metadata against target/decision time; run exact same-input train-vs-serve vector parity; monitor distributions separately with feature-specific thresholds/support; validate manifest compatibility; return `PROMOTED` only when all gates pass and separate `REJECT_LEAKAGE` from `REJECT_TRAIN_SERVE_SKEW`.
theory_code_output.justification: The current terminal demo is diagnostic-only while the prose calls it a blocking promotion gate.

callouts.current_content: Gate features — Train≡serve, sin leakage temporal ni de label. Solo PII sintético (caso Red Andina / workbench CP-N3-B, sin PII real). Si hay timestamps futuros en features, la sección no se considera superada.
callouts.justification: Correct top-level policy; implementation must add availability time and executable failures.

callouts.current_content: Cómo leer este diccionario — Vuelve aquí cuando veas train≡serve, half-open, fs-vN o skew. Cada subtema reutiliza estas definiciones con un mini-demo computable.
Contrato local — catálogo y keys. Si el catálogo existe y el row lo viola: `REJECT_UNKNOWN_FEATURE`. Si falta el catálogo: `REQUEST_CATALOG`.
callouts.justification: Policy is sound; checker must expand beyond keys.

callouts.current_content: Contrato local — indicator y stats de train. Si rellenas sin marcar la ausencia: `REJECT_SILENT_FILL`. Si falta la mediana de train: `REQUEST_MEDIAN`.
callouts.justification: Good fail-closed wording; code must compute it.

callouts.current_content: Contrato local — features de grafo. Si usas label de decisión como input: `REJECT_LABEL_AS_FEATURE`. Si falta el grafo: `REQUEST_GRAPH_FEAT`.
callouts.justification: Correct boundary, but a graph must also satisfy version/as-of/provenance before it counts as present.

callouts.current_content: Contrato local — ventana half-open. Si incluyes el instante t o el futuro: `REJECT_FUTURE_TS`. Si falta el ancho w: `REQUEST_WINDOW`.
callouts.improved_content: Contrato local — ventana point-in-time. Si `w` o la política temporal faltan: `REQUEST_WINDOW_POLICY`. Si un evento viola el cutoff de evento o de disponibilidad: `REJECT_FUTURE_KNOWLEDGE`. Replays con la misma identidad se deduplican o se rechazan según el contrato.
callouts.justification: Event timestamp is not enough when source availability can lag.

callouts.current_content: Contrato local — fit→transform y router por columnas. Si transformas sin fit: `REJECT_TRANSFORM_BEFORE_FIT`. Si falta el state de fit: `REQUEST_FIT_STATE`.
callouts.justification: Desired contract is correct; current router must be brought under it.

callouts.current_content: Contrato local — state versionado. Si sirves sin version: `REJECT_UNVERSIONED`. Si falta el JSON de state: `REQUEST_STATE_JSON`.
callouts.improved_content: Contrato local — artefacto de estado versionado. Si falta el manifest: `REQUEST_STATE_ARTIFACT`. Si id, schema/hash o versión esperada por el modelo no coincide: `REJECT_INCOMPATIBLE_FEATURE_SET`. Solo un artefacto completo y reabierto puede usarse en serve.
callouts.justification: A version field alone does not make state compatible or persistent.

callouts.current_content: Contrato local — split temporal o por grupo. Si hay overlap de entidades: `REJECT_ENTITY_OVERLAP`. Si faltan filas o keys de split: `REQUEST_SPLIT_KEYS`.
callouts.improved_content: Contrato local — split temporal y política de grupos declarados. Rechaza timestamps inválidos, particiones sin soporte o grupos solapados cuando la evaluación exige entidades no vistas; reporta tamaños y exclusiones antes del fit.
callouts.justification: The current helper does not construct a group split and overlap=0 alone is insufficient.

callouts.current_content: Contrato local — scan de leakage, skew y fs-vN. Si hay leaky o skew: `REJECT_LEAKAGE`. Si falta el id del feature set: `REQUEST_FEATURE_SET_ID`.
callouts.improved_content: Contrato local — leakage semántico, paridad/skew y manifest. Información futura/target: `REJECT_LEAKAGE`. Transformación train–serve incompatible: `REJECT_TRAIN_SERVE_SKEW`. Manifest ausente: `REQUEST_FEATURE_SET_ID`. Solo todos los gates verdes permiten `PROMOTED`.
callouts.justification: Keeps blocking behavior while preserving the root-cause distinction taught in the dictionary.

figures.current_content: Caption: Un fit_transform sobre todo el dataset invierte las dos primeras etapas y regala métricas que producción no repetirá. Alt: Cuatro etapas —split, fit, transform, evaluar— con la frontera dibujada tras el split.
figures.justification: Accurately reinforces split-before-fit and aligns with scikit-learn leakage guidance.

figures.current_content: Caption: El mismo feature, la misma fórmula. La única diferencia es dónde termina la ventana — y esa diferencia es toda la fuga. Alt: dos barras sobre corte temporal; la incorrecta cruza test y la correcta se detiene en el corte.
figures.justification: The temporal boundary model is useful; add availability-time nuance in prose/code rather than overcrowding the figure.
